details.title: Easy Living
details.lead: Ralph Rainger, 1937, words by Leo Robin. The chorus as it is written, both endings in their place, in F major: concert D4 to G5. Each A opens with a triplet from A up to D and C, drops to E♭, then climbs by arpeggio to F; the middle part turns to A♭ and rises through B♭ and C to D. The lead sheet marks it medium; here about 92 a minute.
